nodes.why_it_matters: After electronics and steam-power are researched, craft one lab to perform the exact automation-science-pack technology trigger and verify its completion. Do not attempt the locked lab recipe beforehand.

After steam-power is unlocked, establish water supply, boiler steam, engine connectivity and electrical distribution. Verify the connection boundaries and a powered operating load; automatic fuel replenishment remains separate.
Make the 10 bootstrap automation science packs required by automation research, supply a powered lab, and verify automation is researched before crafting assembling-machine-1.

Establish natural coal mining and automatic fuel delivery to the steam plant and burner production equipment, including any burner equipment in the fuel chain itself. Verify live delivery routes and sufficient capacity.
Automatically mine and smelt iron and deliver plates to gear production without manual ore or plate buffers. Size the line and validate transport against the selected science-production rate.
Automatically mine and smelt copper and deliver plates to science assembly without manual ingredient supply. Verify adequate production and transport capacity.
Run a powered assembling-machine-1 producing iron-gear-wheel from automatically delivered iron plates, with verified automatic output delivery for science assembly.

Automatically feed and power science assembly, remove output without blocking, and sustain at least one automation-science-pack per minute over a clean one-minute measurement window. No hand-fed ingredient buffer or manual fuel replenishment may be required.

steps.description: Gather 16 coal for startup fueling of the held copper-production equipment.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather 16 coal as a finite manual startup reserve; retain the held drill and furnace for direct-fed copper production.
execution_guidance.rationale: No coal is held. Startup fuel enables the first resource-processing cell without first building a fuel network; automatic replenishment remains required later.
constraints: Target final held coal count 16.
Do not consume the held production machines.
This is startup fuel, not automated fuel delivery.

steps.description: Install the held burner-mining-drill on natural copper ore; observe its exact identity and actual output position before placing its receiver.

execution_guidance.approach: Use the held burner drill for direct copper-ore supply; validate resource coverage and leave space for a furnace covering its output.
execution_guidance.rationale: The drill and furnace are already held, so this cell needs no machine crafting. Direct feeding adds placement work but avoids repeated hand mining and ore transfers and creates reusable supply. Copper timing remains unmeasured.
constraints: Use native copper-resource coverage validation.
Obtain fresh drill identity and output geometry.
Placement count alone proves presence, not feeding.

steps.description: Install the held stone-furnace at a validated position receiving the drill output; observe its exact identity and verify the direct-feed relationship.

execution_guidance.approach: Place the held furnace using a fresh candidate covering the installed drill's actual output position; then inspect its identity and connectivity.
execution_guidance.rationale: Reusing the held furnace avoids an additional machine bill. Separate receiver placement from drilling because the actual placed output and legal receiving footprint must be observed first.
constraints: Confirm live copper-smelting compatibility.
Use actual output geometry, not remembered offsets.
Verify direct feeding before relying on production.

steps.description: Fuel the copper cell, produce and collect 10 copper plates from naturally mined ore, and verify electronics is researched.

execution_guidance.approach: Fuel the exact drill and furnace from the startup reserve; collect 10 newly smelted copper plates and verify the electronics trigger.
execution_guidance.rationale: The native trigger requires production of 10 copper plates, not a hand-crafting command. Keep one cell until proven; scaling before measurement adds setup without evidence it helps this bootstrap.
constraints: Ore must arrive from the drill, not hand supply.
Completion requires held copper-plate 10 and electronics researched.
Observe working output before waiting on production.

steps.description: Prepare one stone-furnace and retain at least 4 coal for the iron bootstrap; craft the furnace from 5 stone.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather the missing 5 stone and craft one stone-furnace; reserve 4 of the 8 held coal for iron smelting.
execution_guidance.rationale: The furnace recipe needs 5 stone. No furnace item is held. One furnace minimizes setup; a second costs another 5 stone and remains optional rather than part of this kit.
constraints: Preserve the existing copper cell.
Kit requires stone-furnace >=1 and coal >=4.
Resolve missing recipe dependencies before crafting.

steps.description: Install the new stone-furnace near natural iron ore; observe its exact identity before supplying it.

execution_guidance.approach: Choose a reachable iron-ore worksite and place the new furnace nearby; obtain its fresh identity and inspect it before supply.
execution_guidance.rationale: A separate furnace preserves copper production. Exact supply must wait for the newly placed furnace identity; this placement proves presence, not production.
constraints: Use fresh resource/site observations.
Do not dismantle or substitute the copper furnace.
Bind the new furnace identity after placement.

steps.description: Smelt naturally sourced iron ore in the new furnace, collect 50 iron plates, and verify steam-power is researched.

execution_guidance.approach: Hand-mine iron ore in small batches while the fueled furnace smelts earlier batches; collect 50 plates and verify the exact steam-power trigger.
execution_guidance.rationale: Live ideal pipelined estimates are 162 s for manual ore plus one furnace versus 203.2 s for one burner-fed cell, excluding setup and transfers. Manual supply avoids another drill's unresolved iron cost.
constraints: Reserve 4 coal; modeled smelting consumption is 3.6 coal.
Require held iron-plate >=50 and steam-power researched.
Inspect furnace output and working state; no guessed waits.

steps.description: Collect 5 copper plates from the existing copper furnace at (-21, 3), reaching at least 15 held copper plates while retaining 50 iron plates.

execution_guidance.approach: Collect five plates from the freshly identified copper furnace at (-21, 3); verify held copper reaches 15 and iron remains at least 50.
execution_guidance.rationale: The observed furnace contains 16 copper plates. Reusing finished output avoids mining, fueling and new construction; neither a direct-fed expansion nor a smelting row saves time for this deficit.
constraints: Re-observe the exact furnace before transferring.
Preserve the existing copper miner and both furnaces.
Do not spend iron plates during this collection step.

steps.description: Prepare the lab component kit: 10 iron-gear-wheel, 10 electronic-circuit and 4 transport-belt.

execution_guidance.approach: Resolve live component recipes and their combined material bill, then hand-craft exactly the missing quantities for 10 gears, 10 circuits and four belts.
execution_guidance.rationale: The enabled lab recipe requires these three component quantities. Ten circuits require 30 cables, made by 15 cable crafts using 15 copper plates; reuse held iron and avoid production infrastructure for this finite kit.
constraints: Verify gear and belt recipes before computing craft counts.
Account for output multiplicity and reuse held intermediates.
Require all three component quantities in the step checkpoint.

steps.description: Craft one lab from the prepared components and verify automation-science-pack technology is researched.

execution_guidance.approach: Hand-craft one lab, verify its inventory output and re-read automation-science-pack technology after the native production trigger.
execution_guidance.rationale: The exact technology trigger is production of one lab. Crafting the lab unlocks science crafting without requiring lab placement, electricity or lab research in this slice.
constraints: Require lab inventory >=1 and automation-science-pack researched.
Do not attempt the locked science recipe before verification.
Leave steam construction and automation research to later slices.

steps.description: Reach 50 held iron plates for the steam-power kit, reusing the existing iron furnace at (-21, 1).

execution_guidance.approach: Inspect the iron furnace at (-21, 1), collect available plates, then manually acquire and smelt only the remaining deficit to 50 held plates.
execution_guidance.rationale: Eight plates are held, so at most 42 additional plates are needed. An iron furnace already exists but no iron miner is held or established. Reusing it avoids a new mining cell's construction and placement overhead for this finite kit.
constraints: Freshly identify the iron furnace; do not substitute the copper furnace.
Credit stored output before calculating the ore deficit.
Inspect fuel and overlap smelting with gathering where practical.

steps.description: Prepare the remaining materials: 2 copper plates, 5 stone, 2 wood and 20 coal, while retaining 50 iron plates and one lab.

execution_guidance.approach: Collect existing copper output where available; acquire the deficits to 2 copper plates, 5 stone, 2 wood and 20 coal while preserving 50 iron plates and the lab.
execution_guidance.rationale: The enabled recipes require five stone for the boiler's furnace and two copper plates plus two wood for four poles. Reusing the existing copper cell avoids another smelting setup for this small quantity.
constraints: Re-observe the copper furnace at (-21, 3) before exact transfers.
Use live inventory deficits, not the full targets as collection gains.
Require all six retained material quantities in the checkpoint.

steps.description: Prepare the complete steam construction kit: one offshore pump, one boiler, one steam engine, four small electric poles and eight spare pipes; retain 20 coal and one lab.

execution_guidance.approach: Craft one pump, boiler and engine, four poles and eight spare pipes; verify all five kit items, 20 coal and one lab remain held.
execution_guidance.rationale: The combined bill is 50 iron plates, five stone, two copper plates and two wood: 42 iron for the three machines and eight for spare pipes. Two pole crafts produce four poles. Construction waits for fresh shoreline and port geometry.
constraints: Resolve component recipes and output multiplicities before crafting.
Checkpoint every kit item plus retained coal and lab, using mode all.
Do not place equipment or claim water, steam or electrical connectivity in this slice.
